_README: Exposure-calibration pilot (stage 0/1, harness.html): estimation only. An optional tool for a laboratory pilot, not a gate: the two exposure conditions of Exp1 are chosen from the exposure-time literature (author, 2026-09-30), and this harness only measures estimation responses at several durations if a pilot wants them. Display, stimulus, ITI, fixation and the wait for a regular frame clock before the first trial (timing.fullscreen_settle_frames, timing.fullscreen_settle_max_ms) come from experiment_file; only the exposure durations differ. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Paths in '_pilot' are provisional.

keys._note: KeyboardEvent.code values, so a Korean input method does not change them.

instructions: In each trial a cloud of dots appears briefly in the centre of the screen.
Keep your eyes on the small target in the centre until the dots appear.
Then type how many dots you think there were, as a whole number, and press Enter.
If you are unsure, give your best guess. There is no time limit.
text.begin: Press the space bar to begin.
text.prompt: How many dots? Type a number and press Enter.
text.invalid: Please type a whole number from {min} to {max}.
